heroHeadline: High Court Discharges Police Chief Kanja With Stern Warning After Contempt Finding Over Anniversary Roadblocks
heroSubtitle: Justice Patricia Nyaundi accepted Inspector General Douglas Kanja's apology on September 28 and discharged him, warning she would consider a custodial sentence if road closures are again imposed without the notice a standing court order requires; IPOA and DCI still have not named any officer in journalist Alex Kiprotich's September 1 abduction
